tables.title: Gatherer gear rules
rows: For tools, crafting alone can be the goal, because a tool tier unlocks resources: iron for Ironwood and Thorium, thorium for Sunstone ore and Palm wood. Steel and sunstone tools unlock nothing, so they count only once they out-gather what you had.

Tools from iron upward enhance like weapons, up to XV, and each step adds 27.5 power. The enhancement targets in the tiers are estimates; late on, most power comes from runes and curios, not the tool.

Steel tools add only 13 woodcutting and 10 mining power over iron, plus 15% XP. They cost 8 The Crab's Pickaxes and 20 Crystallized Yellow Substance for the pair, so they are worth it mainly for the XP while thorium is still out of reach.
Refine one axe and one pickaxe on the main gatherer and hand them down when you craft better ones.
Give every character an axe: Act 2 ash needs a great deal of wood.
Belt of Love (from killing Yrsainir) adds 10 woodcutting power; event belts suit a parked gatherer for their offline gains.

A trinket with a mining or woodcutting power main stat belongs on the gatherer. Its value follows the piece and its level, and a Harvest piece gives half the power of the matching Halloween one; see the Trinkets system.
For gathering, the pet stats to want are Offline gains with Drop Quantity, EXP or profession power.
What the tools need to reach at each stage is on the Gathering system.
